readCompleteness.sourceReason: The pinned GET returns one selected production/shadow metrics object or null, or the complete exposed map for all production/shadow names. Neither response exposes standalone persisted-skip counters or names present only in that hidden counter map.

visibilityLimits: A named GET returns that name's metrics object or null; null means no exposed production or shadow metrics, not that hidden persisted-skip state is absent.
An all-name GET exposes production and shadow metrics entries; standalone persisted-skip counters and names present only in that counter map are omitted.
The all-name JSON map omits a metric named __proto__; a named GET can still observe that name directly.
A named reset deletes production metrics, shadow metrics, and the selected name's persisted-skip counter.
Reset-all deletes all three counter maps and stops the metrics cleanup interval until module reload.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Built-in models use the registry name and synced models the provider's published name; a model with neither gets a name derived from its id (for example `claude-opus-5-5` becomes `Claude Opus 5.5`). A name shared by several providers is prefixed with the provider (`gh/GPT-5.5`). Omitted when the `MODEL_CATALOG_INCLUDE_NAMES` feature flag is off.

pricing.description: Model price from the same pricing table OmniRoute uses for cost accounting. Omitted when the price is unknown. A combo carries the price of its first visible target. A model with no pricing row that the catalog marks free is `"0"`. The string fields are OpenRouter-compatible (USD per token, plain decimals, no exponent). The numeric fields are USD per 1M tokens. Credit-metered providers (billed per request) carry only the numeric fields, so `prompt` and `completion` are absent for them.

cache_creation.description: USD per 1M input tokens written to the cache.

cached.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens read.

input_cache_read.description: USD per cached input token read. Present when there is a cache price.

input_cache_write.description: USD per input token written to the cache. Present when there is a cache price.

long_context.description: Long-context rate tier from the pricing row, when it has one.

reasoning.description: USD per 1M reasoning tokens, when the pricing row sets one.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Built-in models use the registry name and synced models the provider's published name; a model with neither gets a name derived from its id (for example `claude-opus-5-5` becomes `Claude Opus 5.5`). A name shared by several providers is prefixed with the provider (`gh/GPT-5.5`). Omitted when the `MODEL_CATALOG_INCLUDE_NAMES` feature flag is off.

pricing.description: Model price from the same pricing table OmniRoute uses for cost accounting. Omitted when the price is unknown. A combo carries the price of its first visible target. A model with no pricing row that the catalog marks free is `"0"`. The string fields are OpenRouter-compatible (USD per token, plain decimals, no exponent). The numeric fields are USD per 1M tokens. Credit-metered providers (billed per request) carry only the numeric fields, so `prompt` and `completion` are absent for them.

cache_creation.description: USD per 1M input tokens written to the cache.

cached.description: USD per 1M cached input tokens read.

input_cache_read.description: USD per cached input token read. Present when there is a cache price.

input_cache_write.description: USD per input token written to the cache. Present when there is a cache price.

long_context.description: Long-context rate tier from the pricing row, when it has one.

reasoning.description: USD per 1M reasoning tokens, when the pricing row sets one.

schema.description: An operator-supplied proxy subscription link (Karing-style). `url` is redacted (credentials stripped) whenever the record is returned by the API.

coreBinaryPath.description: Absolute path of the core binary used to verify the generated file before replacing the adopted file. Null means write beside it only.

coreConfigPath.description: Absolute adopted config path: lowercase `.json` renders sing-box, `.yaml`/`.yml` renders Mihomo. Empty means no generation.

mirrorUrls.description: Extra feed URLs, redacted like `url`. Each feed is fetched on its own; a partial failure keeps the unavailable feeds' last nodes.

url.description: Redacted subscription URL. May be a local/loopback address (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8080/list`) — local-first fetch targets are allowed by default (`OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDER_URLS`); cloud-metadata / link-local endpoints (169.254.0.0/16) are always blocked.
